items.prompt: An old forest at dusk: a huge fallen trunk lies across the ground covered in moss, and around it young trees rise straight and close together; the canopy above is unbroken.

alt.ru: Старый лес в сумерках: поперёк земли лежит огромный замшелый ствол, вокруг него тесно поднимаются молодые деревья, полог над ними цел.
alt.en: An old forest at dusk: a huge mossy fallen trunk across the ground, young trees rising close around it, the canopy unbroken.
alt.pt: Uma floresta antiga ao entardecer: um enorme tronco caído coberto de musgo, árvores jovens a erguer-se à volta, a copa intacta.
alt.es: Un bosque viejo al anochecer: un enorme tronco caído cubierto de musgo, árboles jóvenes alzándose alrededor, el dosel intacto.
